title: Document the mailbox directory guard on federation role and central replacement
outcome: Document the mailbox directory guard on federation role and central replacement
acceptance: Operator section and architecture route row explain that a non-empty mailbox directory refuses role or central replacement even without unresolved placements.
Documentation accurately distinguishes disable-with-same-role/identity from role/central migration, and does not promise an unavailable retirement or migration workflow.
Any future directory retirement release path is explicitly scoped and preserves immutable mailbox history and authority fences.
